questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An isolated physical system transitions from initial state parameter $p_i = 16$ to final configuration $p_f = 18$ while conserving the quantity $\mathcal{E} = p_i^2 + 2p_f$. What is the value of $\mathcal{E}$ in SI units?
questions.explanation: Apply the conservation & invariant balance principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Biot-Savart Law for Loops).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two coupled particles of equal mass carry linear momenta in the ratio $1 : 3$. If the slower particle has kinetic energy $K_0 = 17\text{ J}$, what is the combined kinetic energy of the two-particle system?
questions.explanation: Apply the conservation & invariant balance principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Cyclotron Helical Trajectory).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A dynamical coordinate evolves with time $t$ according to $y(t) = 18t^2 - 4t$ (in SI units). Determine the instantaneous rate of change $\frac{dy}{dt}$ at $t = 2\text{ s}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the instantaneous rate & gradient law principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Ampere Circuital Law).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The potential energy of a particle moving along the $x$-axis is given by $U(x) = 5x^3 - 114x\text{ J}$. At what positive position $x > 0$ does the net conservative force on the particle vanish?
questions.explanation: Apply the instantaneous rate & gradient law principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Magnetic Dipole in Uniform Field).

questions.explanation: Apply the boundary ratio & scaling analysis principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Biot-Savart Law for Loops).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When the amplitude of the driving excitation in a linear resistive medium (resistance $21$ units) is multiplied by $7$, by what factor does the rate of quadratic energy dissipation change?
questions.solution: Quadratic dependence on the excitation amplitude yields a $7^2 = 49$-fold increase.
questions.explanation: Apply the boundary ratio & scaling analysis principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Cyclotron Helical Trajectory).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A physical quantity $f(z)$ increases linearly from $0$ to $44$ units over the interval $z \in [0, 8]$. Evaluate $\int_0^{8} f(z)\,dz$.
questions.solution: Area of the right triangle under the linear curve is $\frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times 44 = 176$.
questions.explanation: Apply the graphical slope & area integration principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Ampere Circuital Law).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A linear calibration line has slope $23$ and vertical-axis intercept $-2$. At what value of the horizontal coordinate does the output cross zero?
questions.explanation: Apply the graphical slope & area integration principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Magnetic Dipole in Uniform Field).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A physical observable $Z$ is related to independent measurements $A$ and $B$ by $Z = A^{3} B^{-2}$. If the relative error in $A$ is $1\%$ and in $B$ is $24\%$, what is the maximum percentage error in $Z$?
questions.explanation: Apply the dimensional & exponent homogeneity principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Biot-Savart Law for Loops).

questions.subject: Physics

questions.explanation: Apply the dimensional & exponent homogeneity principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Cyclotron Helical Trajectory).

questions.question: Two coherent harmonic disturbances of amplitudes $A_1 = 26$ and $A_2 = 5$ superpose at a point. What is the ratio of the maximum possible resultant intensity to the minimum resultant intensity?
questions.explanation: Apply the two-source superposition & phase principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Ampere Circuital Law).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An interaction reduces the mechanical energy of a body to $\frac{1}{8}$ of its initial value $E_0 = 232\text{ J}$. How much mechanical energy is lost during the interaction?
questions.solution: Dissipated energy $\Delta E = E_0 - E_0/8 = 232 - 29 = 203\text{ J}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the energy efficiency & dissipation principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Cyclotron Helical Trajectory).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For a mechanical assembly to remain stable, the stiffness parameter $k$ must exceed the critical value $k_c = 30\text{ N/m}$. If the operating stiffness is set to $k = 62\text{ N/m}$, what is the excess stiffness margin $k - k_c$?
questions.solution: The stability margin is $k - k_c = (62) - 30 = 32\text{ N/m}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the critical threshold & equilibrium principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Ampere Circuital Law).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Three coplanar forces keep a point mass in static equilibrium. If two of the forces are mutually perpendicular with magnitudes $31\text{ N}$ and $3\text{ N}$, what is the magnitude of the third force?
questions.explanation: Apply the critical threshold & equilibrium principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Magnetic Dipole in Uniform Field).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The frequency response function $H(\omega) = \frac{128}{\omega + 4^2 / \omega}$ for $\omega > 0$ reaches its maximum value at $\omega = \omega_0$. Determine $\omega_0$ and $H(\omega_0)$.
questions.solution: By AM-GM, $\omega + 4^2/\omega \ge 2(4)$ with equality at $\omega_0 = 4$, giving $H_{\max} = \frac{128}{2\cdot 4} = \frac{32}{2}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the resonance & extremum condition principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Biot-Savart Law for Loops).

questions.explanation: Apply the relative frame & coupling constraint principles in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism (Ampere Circuital Law).
